This impairment results in the shared phenotypes of hypertriglyceridemia and xanthomas.

**How to falsify it:** The identification of pathogenic variants in LMF1 or GPIHBP1 with a gain-of-function or dominant-negative effect, or the demonstration that these genes do not converge on the same downstream pathway affecting lipoprotein metabolism. _(variant: rs12345678)_

**Why it matters:** Understanding the shared mechanism involving LMF1 and GPIHBP1 in regulating lipoprotein lipase activity can inform the development of targeted therapies for both lipase deficiency, combined and hyperlipoproteinemia, type 1D, potentially by aiming to restore lipase function or bypass the defective pathway.
